_comment: Clicking a unit that stands beside a selected deep block selects that unit. A 60-horse cavalry squadron (uid 0) is clicked and ordered north; the Spearmen block beside it (uid 1) sits where the squadron's flank resize grip reaches, since the grip is placed at the deep block's full extent. The Spearmen are then clicked at their centre and ordered north too. Before the fix the press grabbed the squadron's grip instead, so the squadron stayed selected and took the Spearmen's order while the Spearmen stood still; now each block marches on its own order. Drill, seed 1684. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
